subject: general
question: During whose tenure among the following the Swarn Singh Committee was formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Indira Gandhi:**

__
 
• She was the **first female prime minister **of India and the **second **with the **longest tenure**.
 
• She joined as a member of the Congress's Working Committee in 1955.
 
• She declared the **nationalization of banks **in India on July 19, 1969.
 
• She was instrumental in the enactment of the **26th Amendment **to the Indian Constitution, which **abolished the Privy Purse **and **nullified Articles 291 and 362**.
 
• She took a strong decision to stand by the Bangladeshi people throughout the Liberation War.
 
• She was **awarded the Bharat Ratna** in 1972.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Morarji Desai:**

 
• He is the **Finance Minister** **who** has so far **submitted the most budgets.**
 
• He served as the prime minister of India from March 24, 1977, to July 28, 1979.
 
• He was the** first prime minister of India** to be elected **without being a member of the Indian National Congress**.
 
• In addition, at the age of 81, he became the **oldest prime minister** in history.
 
• He reopened ties with China, which had been halted since a 1962 border conflict.
 
• He **made it harder** for any government **to declare a national emergency **in the future.

**Manmohan Singh:**

 
• He was India's prime minister from 2004 until 2014.
 
• He holds the position of India's **third-longest serving prime minister**.
 
• He worked with the Planning Commission that created the five-year plans.
 
• He was appointed as the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India in 1982.He was appointed as the University Grants Commission (UGC) Chairman in 1991.
 
• The **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act** was put into effect in 2005 under his tenure.
 
• His government **instituted Value Added Tax (VAT), **a more streamlined and uniform tax system,** to replace the Sales Tax.**

**​Swarn Singh Committee:**

 
• It was created **to give recommendations** regarding **fundamental duties**.
 
• It **suggested** **adding a section **on fundamental duties **to the Constitution.**
 
• Its recommendations were enacted through the **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act (Article 51A)** in 1976.

 
• The list of Fundamental Duties as mentioned in the Article 51A:

 
 

 
 
S.No.

 
 
 
Fundamental Duties

 
 
 

 
 
1.

 
 
 
Abide by the Indian Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem

 
 
 

 
 
2.

 
 
 
Cherish and follow the noble ideals that inspired the national struggle for freedom

 
 
 

 
 
3.

 
 
 
Uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India

 
 
 

 
 
4.

 
 
 
Defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so

 
 
 

 
 
5.

 
 
 
Promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India transcending religious, linguistic and regional or sectional diversities and to renounce practices derogatory to the dignity of women

 
 
 

 
 
6.

 
 
 
Value and preserve the rich heritage of the country’s composite culture

 
 
 

 
 
7.

 
 
 
Protect and improve the natural environment including forests, lakes, rivers and wildlife and to have compassion for living creatures

 
 
 

 
 
8.

 
 
 
Develop scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform

 
 
 

 
 
9.

 
 
 
Safeguard public property and to abjure violence

 
 
 

 
 
10.

 
 
 
Strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity so that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of endeavour and achievement

 
 
 

 
 
11.

 
 
 
Provide opportunities for education to his child or ward between the age of six and fourteen years.
